description: Header file defining the TpTimer class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It provides a timer utility with start, stop, and callback capabilities, including support for single-shot and recurring timers.

classes.name: TpTimer
classes.description: A timer class supporting start, stop, interval adjustments, and callback execution upon timeout.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the timer is currently active.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the timer and revokes scheduled callbacks.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer with the previously set interval.

methods.name: start(int msec)
methods.description: Sets the timer interval and starts it.

methods.name: setSingleShot
methods.description: Configures the timer to be single-shot or recurring.

methods.name: setInterval
methods.description: Sets the timer interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Assigns a callback function to be invoked upon timer timeout.

methods.name: Timed
methods.description: Internal method invoked when the timer expires, executing the callback and managing timer rescheduling based on single-shot or recurring mode.
